items.title: Show plans on the board
items.about: Umer reviews an agent's plan on a phone: approve or change each section, answer each decision, then send it all back at once.

sections.heading: Goals and non-goals
sections.body:
Goal: one page per plan that Umer can review on a phone in a few minutes.
Non-goal: line-by-line notes on the plan text.

sections.heading: Architecture
sections.body: A plan is a new contract kind. The board stores it like a report, shows it under Waiting on you, and sends the answers back as one event.

sections.heading: Slices and order
sections.body: 1. The contract kind. 2. Store and post. 3. The plan page. 4. Send back. 5. The skill. 6. The demo.

sections.heading: Coding standards
sections.body: Each slice stays under 300 changed lines, tests are integration tests only, and every refusal names the field and one fix.

sections.heading: Risks
sections.body: A long plan does not fit a phone: sections are capped at 8 and each body at 1000 characters.

decisions.question: Send every answer back as one event?
